asr.full_text: Yesterday was kind of a weird, squirrely day for crypto. We pretty much saw a downside most of the day of racing, a lot of the gains that we saw, but we did actually have a great balance back above structure for ADA, for BTC. And we do need to talk about quite a bit of the news. News surrounding uncertainty with the ceasefire. We have news relating to the macro, we have a bunch of Cardano announcements as well. We're going to get into all that in this video so, again, if you're new or haven't already, show your support for the channel down below. Make sure to hit that subscribe button, that bell. It's free to do. It'll keep you updated anytime there's new content live here on the channel. So unfortunately yesterday, we had a bit of a continuation take place from the overnight trading hours. Obviously the overnight trading hours that we talked about yesterday. We were seeing some profit taking, we were seeing some retracement off of that and this all continued as the US market kicked it into gear. You guys can see it right at about 8.30 am CST. We saw a pretty decent drop for ADA and others in the crypto market that we had some of these balances, further retracement, based on some of the news we getting and we will get to get into a crypto market that we had some of these you know bounces further retracements based on some of the news that we're getting and we'll get to that in just a moment but at least as of right now Ada is below uh support resistance or i'm sorry above support resistance which is a great spot to be we're floating around 25 cents at the time of filming this video BTC after dipping down below 71,1 is back above 71,1 so you're watching a little bit of resilience a little bit of conviction in the market hopefully this holds uh especially with some things starting to take place today and and I'll get to that more here in just a moment uh but this all was all you know with lower volume as well we'd obviously climbed to about 120 billion in trading volume that volume dropped to 91 billion so again there was still just a lot of questions a lot of uncertainty with some of the announcements yesterday and let's just start diving right into these so first of all uh day one of the ceasefire bloodiest day of the war in lebanon one of the heaviest days of iranian attacks straighto hormuz still isn't open so this you know even though there is the ceasefire in place there is still a lot of progress that that needs to be made. A few other updates here, the U.S.-Iran ceasefire is shaky and in doubt. There was still pushback on both sides. There hasn't been any strikes between the two of them. Obviously, we talked yesterday about the strikes on Lebanon, if I'm not mistaken, from Iran. So obviously, this is again not a wide stretching ceasefire, it just has to do with U.S and Iran itself. Now, another thing here, no oil or gas tankers have passed through the Strait of Hormuz since the cease-fire was announced. There were only four vessels carrying dry cargo. So, one of the big points was obviously that the Strait of Hormuz was going to be open not not really open per se uh so that is something that does need to obviously be resolved and something that will start taking place today as Iranian ambassador to Pakistan said Iranian delegation is going to be arriving today or I'm sorry Thursday night so that's probably about the time that this video comes out uh over there at least and islam wow is in islamabad for serious talks based on the 10 points proposed by iran which we obviously know that uh the u.s has rejected wholeheartedly uh apparently was thrown in the garbage i saw that announcement yesterday so obviously there is still a lot of work to be done to really get things opened back up to really get things back in the right direction . And so that is why you saw some shakiness, at least in the early part of the day. And in the later part of the day. Now let's talk about the middle part of the day because we're looking at ADA. There was actually a drop that took place right about there, right about one o'clock p.m. Central Standard Time. So why did we why do we see this drop take place? Well, we got the Fed minutes back. And what we heard from this March meeting was that the Fed is, in fact, having a growing openness to potential rate hikes here in 2026. And if you guys remember from years prior, rate hikes were not good for markets. They did not bring a lot of positivity a lot of rise it again created more uncertainty and again completely goes against what we've been where we've been trying to get to the last several years so that is something that we're gonna have to monitor especially in upcoming fed meetings gonna have to pay attention to a lot of the the data that comes out the macro related data and a lot of this uncertainty still, you know, revolves around now the growing uncertainty in the Middle East. So that is directly what the Fed pointed to. Not really that surprising. And that being said, let's dive into a few of the Cardano announcements, because there is significant progress being made with Cardano. So Midnight opens its digital cities. The Midnight Network network has launched the midnight dot fund portal users can now explore all projects and dapps building on the network dive into on-chain games and experience the uh agentic midnight city so that is obviously a really cool update another update here as well kenya is one of the most important financial markets in africa and we wanted to enter it right away this is a a post from uh anson's which if you guys aren't familiar uh they obviously oversee the usda stablecoin on the cardano network today we're announcing a strategic partnership with yashara tokens to bring usda to kenyan banks financial institutions and payment providers yashara uh will lead local minting coordination institutional onboarding and regulatory alignment under the CMA Sandbox Admission. They are the primary interface for the entire Kenyan market So again, Cardano is not done in Africa and This could obviously help accelerate Cardano adoption in in the area there the six million dollar USDA minting program rolls out in phases, starting with the pilot programs and structured adoption with local financial institutions before scaling into broader treasury, settlement, and cross-border use cases. So starting to dive into the same areas as XRP Ledger, as Hedera. So that, again, we're watching Cardano just continue to broaden and take on all these different things. They said, We build where it matters matters and we build with the right partners. Another update here as well, Cardano Governance has approved a treasury-backed venture fund, 50 million ADA allocated to, in the first tranche to Draper, Dragon, and Orion Fund, a shift towards structured capital deployment within the ecosystem. Again, I've pointed to many times that even when the the news gets kind of quiet when it doesn't seem like there's a whole lot going on with cardano there are big things that are taking place behind the scenes behind the scenes big accelerations in terms of adoption uh in terms of use in terms of building with the cardano network and guys we're really just getting started even though the times have been quiet and crypto's kind of sucked as of late uh we're going to come out of this bear market in a very different spot from where we entered and that can again accelerate us into retail adoption and that is why i think that this is one of the most important things uh cryptorover posted this is the time where you buy Bitcoin it will be obviously in hindsight and that is 100 percent true uh just to cover up my camera here you guys can see that we're in one of these drawdown periods for BTC and coincidentally enough these these periods have actually been getting you know shorter over time obviously we had the extended period from 2022 into mid 2023 and that had a lot more to do with again the lack of retail adoption but because as retail adoption was accelerating these periods we're getting shorter because people are again buying these dips taking advantage of it there was more capital rolling into the space so who knows what's going to happen obviously in this bear market i'm still under the belief and understanding that it's going to be shorter it's going to be less deep I mean even just look at a lot of the news that we've been dealing with as of late and it hasn't really sent us into new lows so that's that's at least the the silver lining with what we're dealing with right now so we want to see AIDA hold up today we want to see BTC hold up today that could be again another good floor for us to extend into the weekend. That would show a lot of the conviction ringing through in the crypto market, but we'll see what the day brings us. I appreciate you. Hope you guys enjoyed the video. Let me know your thoughts below and have a great day. Catch you guys in the next one. Take care.
